import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxk = 20;
    static final int maxn = (1 << 20) + 7;
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;
    static int[][] tab = new int[maxk][maxk];
    static int[][] elo = new int[maxk][maxk];
    static int[] maska = new int[maxn];
    static long[][] dp = new long[maxn][2];

    static long pot(long a, long w) {
        long result = 1;
        long base = a % mod;
        while (w > 0) {
            if ((w & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            w >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int daj(List<int[]> kraw, boolean f) {
        int mask = 0;
        int size = kraw.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int[] a = kraw.get(i);
            for (int j = i + 1; j < size; j++) {
                int[] b = kraw.get(j);
                if (a[0] != b[0] && a[1] != b[1]) {
                    for (int k = j + 1; k < size; k++) {
                        int[] c = kraw.get(k);
                        if (a[0] != c[0] && b[0] != c[0] && a[1] != c[1] && b[1] != c[1]) {
                            int val = ((1 << a[1]) + (1 << b[1]) + (1 << c[1]));
                            mask |= maska[(f ? 126 : 0) ^ val];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return mask;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                tab[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            }
        }

        int xd = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j <= 6; j++) {
                for (int k = j + 1; k <= 6; k++) {
                    maska[(1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k)] = (1 << xd++);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = n + 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            tab[i][i] = 100;
        }

        List<int[]> kraw = new ArrayList<>();
        int size = 6;
        for (int i = 1; i <= size; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= size; j++) {
                kraw.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        long odw = pot(100, mod - 2);
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 18); i++) {
                long p = 1L;
                List<int[]> xdList = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int j = 0; j < 18; j++) {
                    if (((1 << j) & i) != 0) {
                        p = (p * tab[kraw.get(j + k * 18)[0] - 1][kraw.get(j + k * 18)[1] - 1]) % mod;
                        p = (p * odw) % mod;
                        xdList.add(kraw.get(j + k * 18));
                    } else {
                        p = (p * (100 - tab[kraw.get(j + k * 18)[0] - 1][kraw.get(j + k * 18)[1] - 1])) % mod;
                        p = (p * odw) % mod;
                    }
                }
                int cur = daj(xdList, k == 1);
                dp[cur][k] = (dp[cur][k] + p) % mod;
            }
        }

        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << 20); j++) {
                if (((1 << i) & j) != 0) {
                    dp[j][0] = (dp[j][0] + dp[j ^ (1 << i)][0]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            long temp = (dp[i][0] * dp[((1 << 20) - 1) ^ i][1]) % mod;
            res = (res - temp + mod) % mod;
        }

        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
